nodes.label: CRAFTER: Multi-Agent Harness for Editable Scientific Figure Generation
nodes.author: Haozhe Zhao, Shuzheng Si, Zhenhailong Wang, Zheng Wang, Liang Chen, Xiaotong Li, Zhixiang Liang, Maosong Sun, Minjia Zhang
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent harness architecture that orchestrates planning, verification, and structured revision around image generators to produce publication-quality scientific figures from diverse inputs without architectural changes across figure types.

nodes.label: CRAFTER System
nodes.rationale: Core contribution: a multi-agent harness for scientific figure generation combining intent reasoner, plan generator, critic, specification refiner, and convergence judge with shared evolving specification as memory.

nodes.label: CRAFTEDITOR System
nodes.rationale: Applies same harness pattern to convert raster figures into editable SVGs through extraction, processing, and composition phases with hybrid critic combining VLM and programmatic checkers.

nodes.label: CRAFTBENCH Benchmark
nodes.rationale: 279-sample benchmark spanning three figure types (academic, poster, infographic) and four input conditions (text-to-image, mask-completion, key-element composition, sketch-conditioned) with human quality annotation and VLM-based evaluation.

nodes.label: Harness Abstraction Pattern
nodes.rationale: Orchestration layer wrapping executor with planning, verification, and structured revision over evolving specification; enables targeted correction without modifying executor itself.

nodes.label: Diversity-Driven Plan Exploration
nodes.rationale: Mechanism treating inter-sample variance as search problem: designer proposes K intent-conditioned candidate plans with distinct visual framings, executor renders all in parallel, convergence judge selects best as starting point for refinement.

nodes.label: Structured Corrective Layer
nodes.rationale: Replaces free-text revision with typed edits on shared specification; prevents prompt contradictions that plague iterative repair by maintaining internally consistent record across rounds.

nodes.label: Verify-Then-Refine Loop with Directive Critic
nodes.rationale: Directive critic emits per-dimension scores and identified defects rather than scalar scores; verify-then-refine loop applies corrections iteratively with best-so-far checkpoint guarding against non-monotonic regressions.

edges.rationale: Both apply harness pattern to different domains (generation vs. raster-to-vector conversion)
Both employ iterative refinement with intermediate evidence accumulation and dynamic strategy adaptation

hyperedges.label: CRAFTER Core Mechanisms
hyperedges.rationale: Three complementary mechanisms that together address high output variance, prompt degradation, and localized errors in scientific figure generation
